# hostd_private_networks (Data Source)

Private networks of a project. `free_ips` lists addresses that `lan_interfaces` can take with `mode = select`. Create the networks in the portal first.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hostd_private_networks" "main" {
  project_id = hostd_project.main.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) UUID of the project (`hostd_project`).

### Read-Only

- `networks` (Attributes List) Private networks in the project. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--networks))

<a id="nestedatt--networks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `networks`

Read-Only:

- `cidr` (String) IPv4 subnet.
- `free_ips` (List of String) Host addresses that no VM or Cloud Gateway uses.
- `gateway` (String) Gateway address of the subnet.
- `has_router` (Boolean) Whether a Cloud Gateway is attached.
- `lan_identifier` (Number) NIC index on a VM: `1` is `net1`.
- `type` (String) Network type. `tag` is an internal VLAN.
- `vnet` (String) Network name. Use it as `vnet` in `lan_interfaces`.
